zh: 新增 iPhone 与 iPad 版本，完整保留查词、个人词汇书、学习、历史和文档导出功能。
单词搜索与词汇书整理改用 Cloudflare 边缘词库批量查询，中国大陆网络下也能更快获得中英文核心结果。
一次可并行准备最多 36 个词条，减少大批量词汇书生成前的等待。
iOS 使用原生 SwiftUI 窗口与导航，并加入 Liquid Glass、弹性滚动和轻量触觉反馈。
修复 Android 底栏快速点击或跨页切换时可能错误进入学习页面的问题。
学习页面的六项独立导航已移到顶部，并在手机上以单行横向栏显示。
当前学习分区会自动滚动到合适位置，切换更直接且不会与应用底栏重叠。
修复 Android 窄屏设置标题与版本号可能溢出的问题，并恢复学习卡片完整的点击反馈。
en: Adds iPhone and iPad builds with dictionary, personal vocabulary books, learning, history, and document export.
Routes search and vocabulary-book preparation through a batched Cloudflare edge dictionary for faster bilingual results, including mainland China networks.
Prepares up to 36 entries in parallel to reduce waiting before large document exports.
Uses a native SwiftUI window and navigation on iOS with Liquid Glass, elastic scrolling, and subtle haptics.
Fixes Android bottom-navigation taps that could incorrectly land on Learning during rapid or long-distance switching.
Moves all six Learning destinations to a single top navigation row on phones.
The selected Learning destination scrolls into view automatically, without competing with the app-wide bottom bar.
Fixes narrow Android Settings title overflow and restores visible touch feedback on Learning cards.

zh: 新增 iPhone 与 iPad 版本，完整支持查词、学习和词汇书导出。
中英文词典结果改由 Cloudflare 边缘批量返回，搜索和生成前准备明显加快。
iOS 窗口与导航改用原生 SwiftUI，并加入 Liquid Glass、弹性滚动和触觉反馈。
修复 Android 底栏快速点击时可能误跳到学习页面的问题。
学习页六个入口移到顶部，并改为单行横向导航。
优化小屏幕的选中项定位、设置标题排版与点击反馈。
en: Adds iPhone and iPad builds with dictionary, learning, and vocabulary-book export.
Returns bilingual dictionary data in Cloudflare edge batches for faster search and document preparation.
Moves the iOS window and navigation to native SwiftUI with Liquid Glass, elastic scrolling, and haptics.
Fixes Android bottom-navigation taps that could incorrectly open Learning.
Moves all six Learning destinations into one horizontal top bar.
Improves selected-tab positioning, narrow Settings layout, and touch feedback.

zh.title: 4.1.0 Beta 5 iOS 与高速边缘词典
items: 首次提供 iPhone 与 iPad IPA；窗口、iPhone 底栏和 iPad 侧栏由原生 SwiftUI 承载，并在支持的系统上使用 Liquid Glass。
iOS 完整支持独立词典搜索、个人词汇书、生成记录、搜索历史、间隔重复学习、设置和多格式文档导出。
普通查询不再依赖甲骨文云词典服务；客户端只连接 Lexora 的 Cloudflare 域名，更适合中国大陆网络环境。
759,561 条带中文释义的 ECDICT 数据被切分为可按需读取的边缘词库，常用词的英文与中文核心结果可同时返回。
搜索和词汇书整理以每组 12 条、最多三组并行的方式预取，单轮最多准备 36 个词条。
文档服务直接接收客户端已解析词条，不再为每个单词重复执行服务器数据库查询。
iOS IPA 为公开自签名包，需要使用 AltStore、Sideloadly、AutoSign 或其他可信签名工具安装。

zh.title: 4.1.0 Beta 4 Android 导航修复
items: Android 应用底栏现在直接定位到用户点击的目标页面，不再让跨页动画经过中间页面并覆盖最终选择。
保留页面左右滑动手势；快速连续点击词汇书、生成记录、历史、学习或设置时，最终页面与选中项始终一致。
学习页的首页、今日学习、今日复习、单词库、统计和学习设置已统一移到标题下方的一行导航中。
手机端学习导航支持横向滑动并自动将当前分区移到合适位置，不再与应用底栏形成双层导航。
修复窄屏设置标题与 Beta 版本号溢出，以及学习设置卡片点击反馈被背景遮挡的问题。

zh.title: 4.1.0 Beta 3 学习系统
items: 学习顶栏调整为首页、今日学习、今日复习、单词库、统计和学习设置。
学习设置可组合使用正确生成过的词汇书、从历史选择的词条以及服务器预设词库。
新增四级、六级、考研、KET、PET、雅思、专四参考和专八预设包的下载、启用和删除。
旧生成记录中的空释义占位词会先联网补全，只有中英文释义均就绪后才能进入评分。
今日学习结束后可直接进入今日复习。

zh.title: 跨平台界面与本地管理
items: 网页 Beta 合并完整词典、词汇书、生成记录、历史、学习和设置，桌面端采用应用式侧栏，移动端采用六项底栏。
Android 学习六项导航改为与网页一致的浮层分段样式，图标和文字居中，并以轻快的非线性动画自动对齐当前页面。
网页学习标题与说明胶囊改为同行排列并上移；设置版本号紧跟标题，减少首屏无效留白。
历史页面的生成历史和搜索历史切换控件移动到标题栏中央。
网页端和应用端新增可逐项选择的缓存清理，每一项以灰色小字显示准确占用大小，默认不删除词条、生成记录、搜索历史或学习进度。
Beta 应用同时检查 Beta 与正式更新通道；当正式版更新程度更高时会优先提示正式版。
修复生成记录并发写入、失败恢复列表和异常拖拽索引等边缘问题，并清理网页代码检查警告。
macOS 保留原生 SwiftUI 侧栏材质，并在选中项和文档自定义等交互表面使用 Liquid Glass。

zh.title: 文档排版
items: macOS SwiftUI Liquid Glass 自定义窗口补充实时生成字体预览。
新增极简模式，每个词条只保留单词和约五个核心汉译。

en.title: 4.1.0 Beta 5 iOS and fast edge dictionary
items: Introduces an iPhone and iPad IPA whose window, iPhone tab bar, and iPad sidebar are hosted by native SwiftUI with Liquid Glass on supported systems.
iOS includes dictionary search, personal vocabulary books, generated files, search history, spaced-repetition learning, settings, and multi-format export.
Normal lookup no longer depends on the Oracle dictionary service; clients contact only Lexora's Cloudflare domain for better reachability in mainland China.
759,561 ECDICT entries with Chinese definitions are split into range-addressable edge shards so common English and Chinese core results arrive together.
Search and vocabulary-book preparation prefetch groups of 12 with up to three concurrent groups, preparing as many as 36 entries per wave.
The document service accepts resolved entries and no longer repeats a server-side database lookup for every word.
The public iOS IPA is unsigned and must be installed through AltStore, Sideloadly, AutoSign, or another trusted signing tool.

en.title: 4.1.0 Beta 4 Android navigation
items: Android bottom navigation now positions the app directly on the requested destination instead of activating intermediate PageView pages.
Horizontal page swipes remain available, while rapid taps across Books, Generated, History, Learning, and Settings always resolve to the selected destination.
Home, Learn Today, Review Today, Library, Stats, and Learning Settings now share one navigation row directly below the Learning header.
The phone layout scrolls the Learning row horizontally and keeps the active destination visible without creating a second bottom bar.
Fixes narrow Settings title and Beta version overflow plus hidden touch feedback on Learning settings cards.

en.title: 4.1.0 Beta 3 learning system
items: Adds Home, Learn Today, Review Today, Library, Stats, and Learning Settings navigation.
Study sources can combine generated books, selected history, and server-hosted preset packs.
Adds downloadable CET-4, CET-6, postgraduate, KET, PET, IELTS, TEM reference packs.
Legacy placeholder words are enriched online and cannot enter review before bilingual definitions are ready.
Completing new learning offers a direct path to today's review.

en.title: Cross-platform interface and local management
items: The web Beta unifies the full dictionary, books, generated files, history, learning, and settings with an app-style desktop sidebar and six-item mobile bar.
Android's six learning tabs now use the same floating segmented style as the web, with centered labels and a quick nonlinear alignment animation.
The web learning title and system badge now share one compact row, while the Settings version sits directly beside its title.
Generated and search history switching now sits in the center of the history title bar.
Web and app builds show the exact storage used by every selectable cache category without deleting entries, generated files, search history, or learning progress by default.
Beta builds check both Beta and stable update channels and prefer the newest applicable release.
Fixes concurrent generated-record writes, failed-list restoration, invalid drag indices, and all remaining web lint warnings.
macOS keeps native SwiftUI sidebar material and uses Liquid Glass on selected and document-customization interaction surfaces.

en.title: Document layout
items: The macOS SwiftUI Liquid Glass sheet now includes a live typography preview.
Minimal mode keeps only each word and about five core Chinese meanings.
